text: dsh-gitlines 是适用于 DSH 网页端的 Git 历史与代码审阅工作台。它在工作区侧栏提供提交图谱、提交概览、文件树和代码差异视图，并把会话编辑记录与可续接的流程检查点放在同一界面。用户可以查看已提交和未提交的改动、阅读提交关联文档、编辑或请求 AI 整理提交说明，还能浏览本地运行进程。适合需要在 DSH 中追踪仓库变化和审阅 AI 开发过程的开发者；需要本地 Git，且 AI 说明由当前配置的模型处理。

dsh-gitlines adds Git history and code review to DSH web. It combines commit graphs with file trees, diffs, session edit records, and workflow checkpoints. Developers can inspect changes, read commit documents, edit or ask AI to prepare overviews, and continue saved workflows. Requires local Git.
想在 DSH 里查看本地 Git 提交图谱
有没有工具能对比某个提交改了哪些文件
我想在工作区检查还没提交的代码差异
让 AI 根据提交内容整理一份可编辑的变更概览
查看一个文件以前在哪些会话里被成功编辑过
怎样把多文件开发阶段保存成可继续的检查点
想按提交查看仓库文档和模块依赖关系
Browse local commit history and inspect exact file diffs in DSH
Keep editable AI explanations and workflow checkpoints with my repository
See which sessions recorded successful edits to a particular file
dsh-gitlines 的功能「提交图谱与变更概览」：查看本地提交历史、作者、分支和父提交关系；选择提交后可阅读变更文件、依赖信息、关联文档和已保存概览。通过侧栏工作台浏览，不会以工作区内容替代指定提交。
dsh-gitlines 的功能「提交与工作区差异」：按指定提交查看文件相对其第一父提交的差异，也可查看当前暂存、未暂存和未跟踪文件的差异。用户从文件树选择文件后在界面中检查变更。
dsh-gitlines 的功能「会话编辑历史」：针对仓库文件查看被记录的成功文件编辑调用及关联流程标记，并可从工作台跳转到对应会话来源。记录用于追溯编辑事件，不描述当前差异的逐行归属。
dsh-gitlines 的功能「保存并续接工作流程」：Agent 可记录阶段目标、摘要、文件、上下文和后续步骤；用户可在工作流中心筛选检查点并准备回到原会话继续处理。

dsh-gitlines README · Gitlines for DeepSeek Harness：让 Git 提交、代码差异和 AI 修改记录出现在同一个工作台。

[English](README.en.md) · [安装包](https://github.com/xiaowuDev/dsh-gitlines/releases) · [问题反馈](https://github.com/xiaowuDev/dsh-gitlines/issues)

Gitlines 是独立安装的 DeepSeek Harness 插件。浏览提交时，先看到改动的原因、影响和上下文；需要核对代码时，再打开文件树和 Diff。AI 可以维护概览，也可以把一次跨文件修改保存成可审阅的流程标记。

dsh-gitlines README · 能做什么：- **提交图谱**：展示作者、分支、提交与父提交的关系；图例解释普通连线和合并。颜色区分历史路径，不代表作者或固定分支。
- **提交概览**：摘要、变更原因、影响范围、核心变更、上下文、依赖关系和相关文档。支持手动编辑或让 AI 整理并保存。
- **文件树与 Diff**：可折叠目录、文件筛选、统一与并排差异、面板拉伸；同时支持已提交和未提交文件。
- **会话追踪**：查看同一文件在不同会话、不同回复中的成功编辑记录，保留具体调用的位置。来源记录和完整原会话各有入口。
- **流程标记**：把目标、涉及文件、完成内容和后续事项归在一起；选择一个流程后，回到原会话继续修改，保留已有草稿，由你发送。
- **文档中心**：按分支和提交组织可编辑的本地归档。
- **本地运行**：显示仓库相关的监听进程与端口，不包含测试结果面板。
dsh-gitlines README · 文件树与代码差异：截图使用公开的 DeepSeek Harness 仓库，来自 Gitlines 开发预览；不包含用户的私有项目或会话内容。
dsh-gitlines README · 安装：本版本针对 **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5**。Harness API 尚未稳定，其他版本请先核对兼容性。Git 需要在本机可执行。

dsh-gitlines README · 桌面版：1. 打开 Harness 的 **插件 → 添加插件**。
2. 粘贴以下固定版本的 GitHub 地址：

```text
   git+https://github.com/xiaowuDev/dsh-gitlines.git#v0.1.0
   ```

3. 安装并启用 **Gitlines**。如果界面未刷新，重启 Harness。
4. 在工作区中选择一个本地 Git 仓库，从侧栏打开 Gitlines。

也可下载 [Release](https://github.com/xiaowuDev/dsh-gitlines/releases/tag/v0.1.0) 中的 `dsh-gitlines-0.1.0.tgz`，通过添加插件入口安装。发布包已包含构建产物，安装时不需要构建插件。

dsh-gitlines README · CLI / Web：在已经安装 `dsh` 的环境中执行：

```sh
dsh plugin add 'git+https://github.com/xiaowuDev/dsh-gitlines.git#v0.1.0'
```

Desktop 的插件由 Desktop 自己管理；不要用 CLI 修改它的专用 profile。

dsh-gitlines README · 常用流程：**了解一次提交**：提交图谱 → 选择提交 → 概览 → 请 AI 整理概览。请求进入该提交的原会话，AI 读取事实与当前版本后保存，完成后自动更新概览。

**审阅未提交修改**：未提交变更 → 展开目录 → 查看 Diff → 会话追踪。历史记录表明某个会话曾编辑文件；它不等于当前 Diff 每一行的作者归属。

**继续一个流程**：流程标记 → 选择流程 → 带入 AI 继续修改。插件重新打开原会话并准备包含流程 ID 的草稿，不自动发送，也不创建替代会话。缓存是否命中仍取决于模型与提供方。

dsh-gitlines README · AI 工具：| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `gitlines_history` | 读取本地提交历史 |
| `gitlines_read_commit` | 读取提交、变更文件与当前概览版本 |
| `gitlines_read_file_diff` | 读取指定文件差异 |
| `gitlines_read_document` | 读取该提交中的相关文档 |
| `gitlines_update_overview` | 按 `expectedRevision` 保存概览 |
| `gitlines_checkpoint_workflow` | 保存一个已完成阶段及其文件、上下文和会话位置 |
| `gitlines_read_workflows` | 读取流程与前序流程 |
| `gitlines_file_history` | 查看一个文件的会话编辑历史 |

AI 的聊天回答不会自动被当作已保存概览；需要成功调用保存工具。并发修改使用版本检查，冲突会明确返回。

dsh-gitlines README · 数据与权限：```text
your-repository/
└── gitlines/
    ├── <encoded-branch>/
    │   └── <full-commit-sha>/

- Git 查询只读，不 fetch、不 checkout、不提交或推送，不修改暂存区。
- 显式保存概览或流程时，写入当前仓库的 `gitlines/`。是否把这些归档纳入 Git 由你决定。
- 会话追踪读取本地 Harness 会话记录。没有成功编辑证据时显示缺失，不猜测归属。
- 插件不收集遥测、不提供独立云端服务。你明确请求 AI 处理时，相关上下文会经 Harness 发送给当前配置的模型提供方。
- 插件 Host 代码在 Harness 进程中执行；AI 归档写入仍遵守 Harness 当前工作区权限与只读模式。

dsh-gitlines README · 兼容性与边界：- 标准桌面版没有公开的原生聊天精确滚动接口。Gitlines 使用自己的来源面板展示具体回复或工具记录，同时提供打开完整原会话的入口；不替换 Harness 的聊天组件。
- 流程标记记录说明与编辑证据，不冻结阶段文件内容。“查看当前变更”展示的是当前工作树。
- 外部编辑器、Shell 命令和插件安装前没有保留的编辑记录不能可靠归属到某个会话。
- 依赖图来自 manifest 声明，不代表完整运行时调用关系；大仓库和会话历史受到读取上限约束，截断会明确标出。
- 本地监听进程发现使用 `lsof`；不支持的平台会显示没有观测到的运行项。
dsh-gitlines README · 卸载：在 Harness 的 **插件** 页面禁用或移除 Gitlines，然后按提示重启。卸载不会删除仓库中的 `gitlines/` 归档或 Harness 原会话。需要删除归档时，请先自行备份。

dsh-gitlines README · 本地开发：```sh
npm ci
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build

源码位于 `src/`，构建脚本位于 `scripts/build.mjs`，插件组合入口为 `cordis.patch.yml`。`lib/` 随版本提交，保证从 GitHub 安装时无需执行构建。修改源码后，请重新构建并一并提交产物。

dsh-gitlines README · Gitlines for DeepSeek Harness：Git history, code diffs, and AI editing context in one workbench.

[简体中文](README.md) · [Releases](https://github.com/xiaowuDev/dsh-gitlines/releases) · [Issues](https://github.com/xiaowuDev/dsh-gitlines/issues)

Gitlines is an independently installable DeepSeek Harness plugin. Start with the reason and impact of a commit, then inspect its file tree and diff. Agents can maintain the overview and record a cross-file stage as a reviewable workflow checkpoint.

dsh-gitlines README · Features：- **Commit graph:** authors, refs, parent connections, and a legend. Colors distinguish history paths; they do not identify authors or permanent branches.
- **Commit overview:** summary, rationale, impact, changes, context, dependencies, and related documents. Edit manually or ask the Agent to save an updated overview.
- **File tree and diffs:** collapsible directories, filtering, unified or side-by-side diffs, and resizable panes for committed and uncommitted changes.
- **Session history:** successful file edits across sessions and replies, with exact tool-call excerpts and links to the original sessions.
- **Workflow checkpoints:** group a goal, files, completed work, and follow-up context. Continue in the original session with a prepared draft while preserving existing draft text.
- **Document center:** editable local archives organized by branch and commit.
- **Local runtime:** repository-related listening processes and ports, without a test-results dashboard.
dsh-gitlines README · Features：Screenshots show the public DeepSeek Harness repository in the development preview. They contain no private projects or user conversations.
dsh-gitlines README · Install：This release targets **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5**. Harness APIs are evolving; verify compatibility before using another version. Git must be available locally.

dsh-gitlines README · Desktop：1. Open **Plugins → Add plugin** in Harness.
2. Paste this pinned GitHub source:

```text
   git+https://github.com/xiaowuDev/dsh-gitlines.git#v0.1.0
   ```

3. Install and enable **Gitlines**. Restart Harness if prompted or if the interface has not refreshed.
4. Select a local Git repository in your workspace and open Gitlines from the sidebar.

dsh-gitlines README · Desktop：Alternatively, download `dsh-gitlines-0.1.0.tgz` from the [release](https://github.com/xiaowuDev/dsh-gitlines/releases/tag/v0.1.0) and add it through the plugin installer. Release artifacts include compiled code; installation does not require a build.

dsh-gitlines README · CLI / Web：With `dsh` already installed:

```sh
dsh plugin add 'git+https://github.com/xiaowuDev/dsh-gitlines.git#v0.1.0'
```

Desktop manages its own plugins. Do not use the CLI to modify Desktop's dedicated profile.

dsh-gitlines README · Workflows：**Understand a commit:** select a commit → Overview → ask AI to prepare the overview. The request uses that commit's linked session; the Agent reads the current facts and revision, saves the overview, and the panel refreshes.

**Review uncommitted work:** open Working Changes → expand the tree → inspect a diff → open Session History. An edit record shows that a session edited the file; it does not establish ownership of every line in the current diff.

dsh-gitlines README · Workflows：**Continue a checkpoint:** select a workflow → continue with AI. Gitlines reopens the original session and prepares context containing the workflow ID. It does not automatically send the draft or create a replacement session. Cache reuse depends on the model and provider.

dsh-gitlines README · Agent tools：| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `gitlines_history` | Read local commit history |
| `gitlines_read_commit` | Read commit facts, changed files, and overview revision |
| `gitlines_read_file_diff` | Read a file diff |
| `gitlines_read_document` | Read a related document from the commit |
| `gitlines_update_overview` | Save an overview using `expectedRevision` |
| `gitlines_checkpoint_workflow` | Record a completed stage, files, context, and session coordinates |
| `gitlines_read_workflows` | Read workflows and predecessor checkpoints |
| `gitlines_file_history` | Read session edit history for a file |
dsh-gitlines README · Agent tools：A chat response is not a saved overview. The Agent must successfully call the save tool. Revision checks report conflicting edits explicitly.

dsh-gitlines README · Storage and permissions：```text
your-repository/
└── gitlines/
    ├── <encoded-branch>/
    │   └── <full-commit-sha>/

dsh-gitlines README · Storage and permissions：- Git queries are read-only: no fetch, checkout, commit, push, or staging changes.
- Explicit overview and workflow saves write to `gitlines/` in the selected repository. You decide whether to commit those archives.
- Session tracing reads local Harness history. Missing successful-edit evidence is reported rather than inferred.
- There is no plugin telemetry or separate cloud service. When you ask AI to process context, Harness sends it to your configured model provider.
- Plugin Host code runs inside Harness. Agent archive writes respect Harness workspace permissions and read-only mode.

dsh-gitlines README · Compatibility and limits：- Standard Desktop does not expose precise native-chat scrolling. Gitlines shows exact replies or tool calls in its own source panel and provides an action to open the complete original session. It does not replace Harness chat components.
- Checkpoints record intent and edit evidence, not frozen file contents. “View current changes” shows the current worktree.
- External editors, shell edits, and missing historical records cannot reliably be attributed to a session.
- Dependency diagrams reflect manifest declarations, not complete runtime call graphs. Repository and history reads have limits; truncation is indicated.
- Local process discovery uses `lsof`. Unsupported platforms show no observed runtime entries.

dsh-gitlines README · Uninstall：Disable or remove Gitlines in **Plugins**, then restart if prompted. Uninstalling preserves repository archives and original Harness sessions. Back up archives before deleting them manually.

dsh-gitlines README · Development：```sh
npm ci
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build

Source lives in `src/`, the build script is `scripts/build.mjs`, and `cordis.patch.yml` defines the plugin bundle. Compiled `lib/` files are committed so GitHub installation needs no build. Rebuild and commit artifacts whenever source changes.
